description: Deterministic Supabase migration manifest for Athena infrastructure reconciliation.

duplicateVersionIssue.cause: Four migrations shared the 20260707 date prefix. Supabase tracks migration version from the leading numeric token; identical prefixes collide in schema_migrations.
duplicateVersionIssue.resolution: Renamed to unique 14-digit timestamps (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) preserving chronological order.

migrations.purpose: Baseline core intelligence tables (communities, discussions, analysis, opportunities, briefings, domain intelligence).
migrations.notes: Previously existed only in production; required for fresh db push.

migrations.purpose: Knowledge base assets and asset links.
Athena Brain identity profile and identity documents.
Master identity profile JSON columns on athena_identity.
Add user_id to core tenant-owned tables.
Discussion thread updates for refresh and analysis.
Organizations, members, organization_id columns, demo org backfill.
SaaS tenant provisioning functions, relationship-based org backfill, identity uniqueness per org.
migrations.notes: Does not backfill tables without user_id; uses FK propagation. Renamed from 20260710_saas_tenant_provisioning.sql

manualProductionSteps: Existing production projects that already applied old 20260707_* versions must NOT re-run renamed migrations. Insert manifest rows manually or use supabase migration repair if versions were partially applied.
Fresh projects: run supabase db push with no manual SQL edits.
auth.users must exist (Supabase Auth enabled) before 20260707000001 and 20260710000001 provisioning functions run.
